 Order
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 504/2021 of PS Tilak Nagar for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.

3. Learned counsel for petitioners seeks and is allowed opportunity to implead Mr. Trilochan Singh,
brother-in-law of respondent no.2.
4. Learned APP accepts notice and opposes the petition on the ground that the FIR contains allegations of sexual misconduct against brother-in-law This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 07/04/2026 at 21:47:01 of respondent no.2.
5.
The status report be filed within four weeks.
This is a digitally signed order.
